quotes: The soul becomes dyed with the colour of its thoughts.||Marcus Aurelius
Worry rehearses a story. Ask what is actually true right now.
Write the worry down. A page holds it so your mind doesn't have to.
Talk to yourself the way you would talk to a friend in your shoes.
posts.caption:
Choose your thoughts with care. 🌧️

Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 5.16 (translations vary). General psychology ideas, not medical advice.

quotes: He who conquers others is strong; he who conquers himself is mighty.||Lao Tzu
posts.caption:
Quiet strength. 🌱

Lao Tzu, Tao Te Ching ch. 33 (translations vary).

quotes: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act but a habit.||Will Durant
Make the habit so small you cannot say no. Two minutes counts.
Attach a new habit to one you already do. Coffee, then stretch.
Missing once is a slip. Missing twice starts a new pattern. Return quickly.
posts.caption:
Small, repeated, kind to yourself. ⏳

Will Durant, The Story of Philosophy (1926), summarizing Aristotle. General psychology ideas, not medical advice.

quotes: Make the best use of what is in your power, and take the rest as it happens.||Epictetus
posts.caption:
Hold what is yours to hold. 🍃

Epictetus, Discourses (translations vary).
